content:
PR #35951 adds theory for exact pairings with isomorphic evaluation and coevaluation (CategoryTheory/Monoidal/Rigid). This includes:

  1. A definition that swaps ExactPairing X Y to ExactPairing Y X by inverting (and swapping) the evaluation and coevaluation morphisms, and
  2. Isomorphisms from ᘁX ⟶ Xᘁ.

Motivation: Adding CategoricalGroups to mathlib, which can be defined as right rigid groupoids. The approach is motivated by the discussion with @Robin Carlier in an earlier PR #34830.
